card.name: Morning and daily-start phrases
card.fires_on: Words that follow a morning time or waking cue and lead into 'morning', 'day', 'daily' or waking, such as 'in', 'every', 'the', 'routine'. Seen in stories about daily routines and in dosing text about taking something on waking.

modes.label: Getting up and starting the day
